title.zh: 多智能体蜂群协作：从行业进展到可落地的最佳实践
title.en: Multi-Agent Swarm Collaboration: Industry Progress and Practical Engineering Patterns

summary.zh: 基于已复核的官方工程文档与多智能体失败研究，用技术选型案例解释模式选择、产物共享、单写者、权限隔离、成本和可验证交付。
summary.en: Uses verified engineering documentation and multi-agent failure research to explain topology selection, artifact sharing, single-writer boundaries, permissions, costs, and verified delivery.
